# The Strategic Master Library — full reference for language models

Author: Kenneth E. Sweet Jr. · ORCID 0009-0001-4237-1243 · https://KESJr.com

Cost: $0. No email, no account, no third-party trackers, ads, or cookies.
Library seal (SHA-256): 029909fbe9bd13468ec11dc7ae22f77d39b35d12249c79213b1476c71cde104d

## What it is

Six volumes distilled from twenty-nine audited project owner's manuals, plus
the two-stage toolkit that produced them. The subject is how to build software
that survives its author: how to document honestly, what to own versus what to
ship, and how to keep a solo founder's claims from drifting away from reality.

The package is compiled deterministically. The same markdown inputs produce
byte-identical HTML, so anyone can re-run the compiler and confirm the seals.
That property is the point: the library practises the verification discipline
it argues for.

## The two-stage toolkit

Stage One — The Owner's Manual Patch. Generates an eighteen-section,
truth-labeled owner's manual for a project: what it is, what it runs on, what
is real, what is intended, and what would break first.

Stage Two — The Truth Audit Patch. A forensic pass over Stage One output. It
re-checks each claim against the codebase, demotes anything overstated, and
publishes a correction log rather than silently editing the original.

## The truth-label legend

CONFIRMED — Directly verifiable in the codebase, database, or shipped product.
OBSERVED — Present in committed docs, migrations, or memory files; load-bearing intent.
INFERRED — Synthesized from multiple sources; reasonable but not directly stated.
PLANNED — Explicit roadmap item, not yet shipped.
SPECULATIVE — Strategic projection or vision. Not a promise.
NEEDS CONFIRMATION — A gap; verify before quoting externally.

## Certificate of Ownership

A free, numbered, SHA-256 sealed record that a copy exists in the public
register at https://shpbl.com/certificate. It is provenance, not copy
protection: nothing in the library is locked or degraded without one.
Certificate 001 is the Publisher Verification Copy, issued during launch
verification before public circulation.

Permitted: read, print, archive, quote with attribution, use commercially in

The tooling (toolkit patches and compiler) carries looser terms than the prose.
Full text: https://shpbl.com/license

## Privacy

No third-party trackers, ads, or cookies. Only anonymous first-party counts
stored on the site's own backend, with no personal data and no cross-site
identity. /pulse is a private, key-gated dashboard and is not indexed.

## Frequently asked

Is it really free? Yes — all six volumes, the toolkit, the markdown source,
and the deterministic compiler download as one zip at no cost.

What format? Each volume is a single self-contained HTML file with print CSS
built in. Open it in any browser or print to PDF for the boxed set.

What is the seal for? Every volume and the library as a whole carry a SHA-256
seal over a deterministic build, so anyone can confirm nothing drifted.

Can I read it without downloading? Yes — every volume renders in the browser
at https://shpbl.com/read/{volume-slug}, byte-identical to the download.

Does it work offline? Yes. The site is an installable progressive web app;
the landing page, volumes, toolkit, and license are cached after first visit.
